back: The worldwide infrastructure of interconnected networks (hardware and connections).
The collection of websites and web pages accessed using the internet.
A text-based address for a web page: protocol, domain name and path/file name.
Hypertext transfer protocol: rules for requesting and sending web pages.
HTTP with encryption (SSL/TLS); the browser checks the site's certificate.
Domain name server: finds the IP address that matches a domain name.

front: Main purpose of a web browser
back: To render HTML and display web pages.
Address bar, navigation tools, tabs, bookmarks, history, storing cookies.

front: Loading a page in four steps
back: DNS turns domain name into IP address → browser requests page from web server → server sends HTML → browser renders it.
